tool_action.public_message: I'll hold onto Kentucky for now, Claude. With both Illinois and Atlantic still in the bank—and you sitting on over $1,000 cash—I'd rather wait until those deeds are off the board before we look at consolidating Red and Yellow.
tool_action.private_thought: Reject p2's offer of Marvin Gardens + $50 for Kentucky Avenue. Right now both Red and Yellow are split 1-1 between me and p2 while Illinois Avenue and Atlantic Avenue are still unowned in the bank. Giving p2 two-thirds of the high-traffic Red set when p2 holds $1,079 cash (enough to easily win any auction for Illinois and immediately build houses) is far too dangerous compared to my $436 cash. It is strictly better for me to keep both Red and Yellow blocked until Illinois and Atlantic are purchased.
